title: Gold & Silver Keys
description: Changes Trial Key & Ominous Trial Key textures to gold and silver keys
body:
## **Main Information**

This Pack just changes 2 textures:

Trial Key -> Gold Key

Ominous Trial Key -> Silver Key

## **Alternate Ways to Download Gold & Silver Keys**
